claim: On current source, an established camp with a declared setup-only Patrol zone can use native semantic camp-board job assignment to set a stationed worker's Patrol priority to nine, enter native Patrol runtime with an authoritative current shift-cache target/route, and release that worker by returning the priority to zero.
material_proof: A selected current-source run records the Patrol zone only as setup; then retains accepted native receipts for board/job-assignment entry, the current Patrol-priority menu selection, numeric priority nine, native elapsed time, direct camp-worker inspection with current patrol shift-cache/runtime target and route, numeric priority zero, and direct post-release state.
material_contradiction: Patrol footing is inferred or credited as runtime
the job-assignment route or priority entry lacks matching native receipt
priority nine lacks direct worker runtime ownership/position and current shift-cache target/route after native elapsed time
priority zero lacks direct post-release state
a physical key, OCR, coordinate, callback, direct state/save mutation, or synthetic receipt is used
already_accepted_evidence: The prior fresh R-032 diagnostic established that native priority one is deferred by prepared workers' existing priority-eight work; it did not establish Patrol runtime.
The prior priority-nine observation-gap run did not promote disappearance from the visible set to runtime evidence.
Prepared-fixture transforms provide only zero-credit zone and material footing.
current_uncertainty: The current board availability, native job editor entries, chosen worker, Patrol runtime target/route/position, and priority-zero release must be observed.  The camp-worker inspector's shift-cache diagnostic can refresh a plan but does not synchronize or mutate the actor order; job-menu reachability and a fixture zone alone establish neither assignment nor runtime.
forbidden_shortcuts: physical keys, hotkeys, OCR, screenshots, coordinates, or guessed controls
direct NPC, camp, mission, item, zone, or save mutation after fixture install
crediting fixture zones, startup, or board opening without the named assignment/runtime/release result
honest_stop_conditions: stop before launch if no active source-matched registry selection exists
after launch, retain unavailable job assignment, Patrol entry, runtime, or release as its own precondition result
seal only after native priority-nine and priority-zero selections, direct runtime/release state, and cleanup are cited
